capability.summary: Validate one JSON file against one JSON Schema file
capability.description: Loads an instance and schema from separate JSON files, calls jsonschema.validate, and reports either valid=true or valid=false with the first validation error message.
capability.problem_space: Binary conformance checking of one file-backed JSON instance against one file-backed JSON Schema.

constraint.io_signature: Inputs: instance JSON file path and schema JSON file path; output: JSON result with valid boolean and, on instance validation failure, an error message.
accepted_inputs: a readable file containing any valid JSON instance
a readable file containing a JSON Schema accepted by the installed jsonschema library
constraint.output_shape: A conforming instance produces an object with status="success", tool="lib.jsonschema_validate", and valid=true. A jsonschema.ValidationError is also a success object with the same tool, valid=false, and error as the validation message. Any other caught file, JSON, schema, or library exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.jsonschema_validate", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: reports only the first validation failure selected by jsonschema.validate, not a complete iterable of all errors
does not expose validation paths, schema paths, contexts, or structured error metadata
schema draft selection and format behavior follow the installed jsonschema library and the schema's declarations
invalid schemas, malformed JSON, missing files, and other non-ValidationError failures use the wrapper's error envelope rather than valid=false

output_contract.description: Validation verdict with valid boolean and an error message only when the JSON instance fails schema validation.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.
